_comment: World dressing P2-041 (OFF until GPU judged; coordinator Meshy Crown Arch, tb/props-r2 a2f81b50, assets/props/meshy-1031/crown_arch, provenance there). GPU 31 Oct 4.23 main / 4.56 octagonal landing; judges asked for a hero arch taller than the trainer with a crown keystone and crystal or copper accents, rooted in moss not on a slab. The Meshy arch replaces the visible arch at 5.5 m (3x the 1.80 m trainer); the old arch piece and slab mesh are hidden, not freed, so the 9x9 m footing collider, the 2.2x2.5 m passage trigger, the travel axis and placement are unchanged (scripts/world/stormwood_crown_arch_hero.gd). The grass clearance shrinks so moss grows to the pillars. Crystal texels get the blue-vein glow.
